text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A water bottle frozen on an angle! Slap it 
right onto a chilly forehead! And salt 
replenishment candy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Checklist, coin pouch... Must not forget 
the entry pass! Everything else looks good 
too!! Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As long as the delivery of the new books 
goes smoothly, everything should be just 
fine~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I need to check out the neighbor's 
new release too. Their genre is the same 
as ours, Umamusume-chan—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah--!! Th-This is...! Incredible! The 
cover alone overflows with preciousness, 
it's peak MAX spectacle...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyooo, this is a must-buy! I'm buying it! 
Please let me buy it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? I feel like I've seen this 
wall-circle's art style somewhere 
before... Especially the way they draw the 
ears...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could this person be... Umakko 
Pyonkichi-san, who once took the world by 
storm in the anime 'UMA★Dream World 
Berserker'?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa, you came over here too! You're 
alive!! Digi-tan has been waiting for you 
in original work territory...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Looks like this 
summer's gonna be a hot one too...! Events 
are the best!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Refreshments... I must prepare some 
refreshments... Considering it's summer, 
for example—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Non-perishable items would be the first 
condition. Other than that, fundamentally, 
keeping the outside air cool is essential 
too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"While sodium and hydration are 
essential... drinking too much water just 
because you're thirsty can actually be 
dangerous."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. Besides, most circles bring their 
own drinks anyway!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, letters really 
are the best, huh~! Digi-tan got a fan 
letter before too and was suuuper happy 
about it~... Ehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. So something is happening this 
summer that makes you this talkative. Hmm, 
fascinating indeed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Digital. Tell me all about this 
'summer event' of yours!
